name: s81dvbk_selvl
structural_change: PL-BK 10-18 (PARENTS-LANDED): the S81U-BK3 vertical-cut selector (selv plan, S81-TILES6 rung relays) as a LANDED parent: 3 clock regions (core = glue + control + 4 quarters, rs = u_rs, rn = u_rn), the two 276-b relay -> glue rung crossings landed (+3 edges per direction; record results/arch/landed_parent_1018/dsdv_bk_sel_x). The quarters <-> control credit loop and the glue -> quarter -> control -> glue path are one strongly connected set: kept inside the core region (a landing there needs a compiler / SLAT re-schedule). NOT GATEABLE YET: s81dvbk_sq and s81dvbk_selc2 have no closed views.

job.benched_by: tools/landed_parent lockstep bench (dsdv_bk_sel_x_lp_bench.sh) + run_bk_bench.sh sel with LP=1

rung_relays.decision: coordinator S81-TILES6 10-17: the sel rung segment (~518-562 um > 405) takes ONE closed 276-b relay per direction inside the cluster (instead of die stations at the unit faces)

views.u_rs: s81dv_rly_276_sn (closed s81dv_rly_276_sn dv4c: TT +378.10 / FF +24.26 ps, DRC 0; 25.92 x 17.28, i S / o + ck_o N / ck + rs E)
views.u_rn: s81dv_rly_276_ns (closed s81dv_rly_276_ns dv4c: TT +383.87 / FF +28.89 ps, DRC 0; 25.92 x 17.28, i N / o + ck_o S / ck + rs E)

rung_relays.placement: northbound: vi_s (S face, x 479-557) -> u_rs at (518.4, 43.2), 43 um in -> glue vi_s (S face of u_g, y 561.6): ~500 um + <= 65 um jog, one registered hop inside the measured repeated reach (600-750); southbound: vi_n (N face) -> u_rn at (518.4, 1252.8) -> glue vi_n. The glue outputs vo_n / vo_s run ~562 um to the faces and land in the NEXT unit's face relay (abutting units), so every rung hop is one relay-to-glue or glue-to-relay segment. To make room the S quarter row moves up 43.2 (y 43.2 -> 86.4; middle channel 43.2) and the N quarter row moves down 43.2 (820.8 -> 777.6); every quarter <-> glue / control hop shortens.
rung_relays.latency: +1 cycle per direction per sel unit on the V rung (vstop schedule: SLAT / rung arrival re-derived by the compiler; report to the model)
rung_relays.rtl: DONE (S81-TILES8/bk 10-18): dsdv_bk_sel.sv instantiates dsfd_dvrly_276_SN u_rs (.ck(clk), .rs(rst_n), .i(vi_s) -> vi_s_r) and dsfd_dvrly_276_NS u_rn (.i(vi_n) -> vi_n_r) in the hard and soft builds alike; the glue takes vi_s_r / vi_n_r; ck_o unused. Bench model tb_dsdv_bk_wrap RL = 1 for the sel unit (+1 rung cycle per direction); run_bk_bench.sh compiles rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv + dsfd_rly_masters_dv276.sv.

regions.core: u_g, u_c, u_q0..3 (clock entry ck_core on the E face beside the glue / control register mass)
regions.rs: u_rs (S face; ck_rs entry on the S face beside it)
regions.rn: u_rn (N face; ck_rn entry on the N face beside it)

landed_parent.landings: vi_s_r rs->core, vi_n_r rn->core (276 b each; ring write half beside the relay, read half beside the glue vi_s / vi_n pins)
landed_parent.open: soft landing halves are placed by the placer (no site file yet): check the gate PNG that u_lpl_0_w / u_lpl_1_w sit beside u_rs / u_rn and the read halves beside u_g
